newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norske Skog sees weaker Q496 than Q495.
newsitem.headline: Norske Skog sees weaker Q496 than Q495.

text.p: Norwegian forestry company Norske Skogindustrier ASA said on Thursday it expected to post a weaker financial result in the fourth quarter of the year than in the corresponding quarter in 1995.
In a statement releasing nine-month results, Skog said the market for its main product, print paper, had gradually weakened during the course of 1996.
"The fourth quarter is expected to show weaker earnings than earlier in the year, mainly because of stronger competition in Europe from Canadian and Russian newsprint suppliers," the company said.
Despite higher demand for fine-grade paper, the market for pulp remained characterised by uncertainty, Skog said.
Norske Skog posted nine-month operating profits down 6.5 percent at 1.48 billion crowns compared with 1.59 billion crowns a year-ago period.
Pre-tax profits slipped almost 11 percent to 1.32 billion crowns against 1.48 billion crowns in the January to September period in 1995.
